purpose: Defines constants and configuration dataclasses for the annotation pipeline. Bundles stage-8 rally segmentation/contact-detection thresholds, stage-9 replay/off-rally rules, doubles guards, and two preset classes (BaseAnnotatorConfig and ResolvedAnnotatorConfig) that callers pass to video annotation runs.

public_api.name: SCRAPE_DIR
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Path to scrape-output root (flat CSVs + per-video sidecars). Reads from BADMINTON_SCRAPE_DIR env var or defaults to repo data/scrape_output.

public_api.name: MASKS_DIR
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Path to masks subdirectory under SCRAPE_DIR (schema s2 stage 9).

public_api.name: RALLY_SPANS_CSV
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Path to rally_spans.csv in SCRAPE_DIR (spec s6 stage 8).

public_api.name: CONTACT_FRAMES_CSV
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Path to contact_frames.csv in SCRAPE_DIR (spec s6 stage 8).

public_api.name: REST_SPEED
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Speed threshold in norm-units/frame; a span is at rest below this (stage 8).

public_api.name: REST_WINDOW
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Window size in frames (~0.16s at 25fps) for rest detection (stage 8).

public_api.name: START_SPEED
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Speed threshold to detect rally start; speed above this triggers detection (stage 8).

public_api.name: START_MIN_FRAMES
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Minimum consecutive frames above START_SPEED to confirm rally start (stage 8).

public_api.name: SMOOTH_WINDOW
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Moving-average window size for trajectory smoothing to survive TrackNetV3 jitter (stage 8).

public_api.name: END_REST_FRAMES
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Minimum extended rest duration in frames (~3.0s) to mark rally end (stage 8).

public_api.name: PROXIMITY_MAX
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Max player-proximity distance in norm court units; used as guardrail cross-check (stage 8).

public_api.name: PERSPECTIVE_SHIFT_THRESHOLD
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Reprojected-corner displacement fraction of frame size; detects perspective shifts between segment homographies (stage 9).

public_api.name: SLOWMO_SPEED_FRAC
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Speed threshold as fraction of rally median to detect slow motion (stage 9).

public_api.name: COMPOSITION_CONTENT_THRESHOLD
public_api.role: Module-level constant. PySceneDetect ContentDetector threshold for composition dead-mask (stage 9).

public_api.name: COMPOSITION_KEEP_VOTE
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Fraction of frames voting court-view needed to keep a cut segment in composition mask (stage 9).

public_api.name: DOUBLES_SPAN_FRACTION
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Fraction of rally frames (>0.5) where over-count >2 must hold to fire doubles flag (stage 8).

public_api.name: Stage8Thresholds
public_api.role: NamedTuple bundling the 10 stage-8 trajectory-rule thresholds. Allows passing a preset threshold set to segment_video instead of relying on module globals. Default preset: SHIPPED_THRESHOLDS.

public_api.name: SHIPPED_THRESHOLDS
public_api.role: Module-level constant. Pre-built Stage8Thresholds instance with the default shipped stage-8 values; equivalent to passing no thresholds override.

public_api.name: BaseAnnotatorConfig
public_api.role: Frozen dataclass holding non-fps-sensitive configuration for an annotator run (thresholds, dead-mask mode, smoothing strategy, span-opening, reentry guard, rejected grades). Validates invariants in __post_init__; fps-sensitive fields are scaled at resolution time.

public_api.name: ResolvedAnnotatorConfig
public_api.role: Frozen dataclass for the final per-video configuration after fps scaling. Holds fps, FpsConstants, scaled thresholds, and strategy fields ready to pass to run_video (marked never to be rescaled).
